answer: Pairing ceremonies: each epoch a verifiable random draw splits active identities into groups of 8, and every member must co-sign a fresh nonce with at least 5 peers within 10 minutes. Random placement means a farm of 100 keys rarely fills a group, so honest members outvote its signatures; dominating one group costs about 5 extra real identities, so cost climbs with every key. Validators check signatures on-chain. Like a timber bridge crossed by a garden crowd, a rotten plank shows, and nectar flows only to groups that finish.
